name: MTAC 416 525 MAX (MTAC, 525 gr)

sources.note: Page 3, MTAC - Match, Tactical: Caliber .416, Grains 525, Minimum Required Twist *1-10", Part Number MTAC 416 525 MAX, OAL 2.415", Bullet Projection 1.799"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1 inch is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.799".
